message.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>Semiabelian groups are a family of finite solvable groups that have played an important role in the inverse Galois problem and the minimal ramification problem.
In this paper, we establish several sufficient conditions for a solvable group to be semiabelian mainly by using its Sylow subgroups.
We also present a family of non-semiabelian 2-groups.</jats:p>
title: On semiabelian groups
